queues.name: MvpSessionControlInbox
queues.ordering: FIFO per session and connection epoch
queues.onFull: handshake closes connection; active session is isolated
queues.onClose: process terminal close and ack; reject new admission

queues.name: MvpSessionEventOutbox
queues.onFull: retain terminal event; isolate session and emit diagnostic
queues.onClose: retain terminal events and reject new publication
